## Summary

Describe the user-visible Code Factory change and why it is needed.

## Scope

- [ ] Changes limited to Code Factory
- [ ] No other GitHub Activity Studio concepts or profile README modified
- [ ] No unapproved publication, licence, visibility, package or release changes

## Activity and source integrity

- [ ] Machines/cargo map to real or clearly marked synthetic source events
- [ ] No invented official contribution totals, CI builds or deployments
- [ ] No private repo data, credentials or unsafe SVG content
- [ ] Dense, idle and malformed-input cases considered

## Verification evidence

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] `npm run verify:exports`
- [ ] Browser preview or screenshot checks where UI changed

## Assets and documentation

- [ ] Derived SVGs deliberately regenerated and diff reviewed if needed
- [ ] README, docs and `AGENTS.md` or handover updated if interfaces changed
- [ ] Windows and Linux compatibility considered

## Known limits

State precisely what was not verified and any affected source coverage.
